GoalOptions.Label: Accelerate Onboarding
GoalOptions.Text: Enable new engineers to rapidly understand the Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system's architecture, event flows, and core components within their first week. Success means they can confidently trace an event from ingestion to resource adjustment and identify relevant codebases for each service.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Contribution
GoalOptions.Text: Equip mid-level developers with the knowledge to effectively contribute to feature development, debugging, and performance tuning of the event-driven AI system. This includes understanding prediction model integration, scaling logic, and data ingestion pipelines to propose improvements.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize System Usage
GoalOptions.Text: Provide developers with the necessary context to make informed decisions when interacting with or extending the resource scaling system. This goal aims to reduce misconfigurations, improve resource allocation strategies, and ensure adherence to performance and cost reduction targets.

GoalOptions.Label: Foster Innovation
GoalOptions.Text: Inspire developers to identify opportunities for enhancing the Predictive Resource Scaling & Optimization system, such as improving prediction accuracy, optimizing event processing, or integrating new data sources. Success means developers can articulate potential system improvements and their impact on key non-functional targets.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Proficiency & System Understanding
Criteria: New engineers can accurately describe the role of the Data Ingestion Service, Prediction Engine, and Resource Orchestration Service.
Developers can trace the lifecycle of a resource scaling event, identifying key data transformations and service interactions.
Engineers can locate and understand the code responsible for a specific prediction model or scaling decision logic.
The document enables developers to debug a simulated resource allocation issue by following documented procedures.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Efficiency & Impact
Criteria: The document contributes to a 20% reduction in time-to-first-contribution for new engineers on the resource scaling team.
Developers can identify and implement a code change that improves prediction accuracy by 2% or reduces cloud spend by 5%.
The handbook's guidance leads to a 10% reduction in critical production incidents related to resource scaling misconfigurations.
Engineers can leverage the document to optimize an event processing pipeline, reducing latency by 1 minute for scaling decisions.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Architectural Adherence & Best Practices
Criteria: Developers consistently implement new features following the documented event-driven architectural patterns.
Code reviews frequently reference the handbook for adherence to data ingestion and prediction model integration standards.
The document ensures new contributions maintain the system's ability to make real-time scaling decisions within 5 minutes.
Engineers can articulate how their code changes contribute to or maintain the target of >90% prediction accuracy for critical resources.
